set.body: Evidence: LoopPlan already classifies LinearContiguous, ScalarBroadcast, InnerStrided, and GeneralStrided, but ElementKernels.loopOffsets ignores kind and always runs the general counter machine. The raw 65536-element JVM add is near the NumPy scale while public contiguous_add measured 0.119x NumPy. Dispatch once by dtype, operation, and loop kind into small monomorphic methods: flat contiguous, scalar-broadcast, nested inner-stride, and general fallback. Extend the pattern from add to the built-in unary, binary, comparison, and predicate families without duplicating semantic policy. Acceptance: unchanged signatures and laws on JVM and Scala.js; output allocation plus at most 2048 bytes; elementwise geomean at least 0.50x NumPy with no case below 0.30x at both sizes; raw/public decomposition shows planning plus dispatch within 20 percent of the allocation-and-kernel control; javap and optimized-JS inspection prevent another oversized dispatcher.
set.title: Dispatch elementwise kernels by validated loop kind
